name: Conveyor_aankws 直线输送机
description: 固定几何直线皮带输送机的初始契约；单向整带驱动，具备持续运行、速度调整、受控停止及按物料的入料/运输/出料任务声明。执行器尚未接入。
notes: 本文件为 DeviceSpec 声明，不是 JSON Schema Draft 校验器。
GLB 原生采用 Y-up；不沿用旧 conveyor_1 的 Z-up 工艺点。所有本地长度为 m，旋转为 rad。
从实际顶点提取几何边界，工艺方向、端口和支脚锚点仍需业务/几何标定。
当前网格没有内置动画，也没有骨骼。皮带顶层没有 UV 属性且无纹理，初版预览应移动载荷，不能假定可直接滚动皮带纹理。
仅定义当前整带驱动能力；不声明独立分区积放、反转、FPM 兼容反馈和虚拟停留点电机。
速度、容量、加减速时间和容差是初始仿真设计值，不能由 GLB 推断为真实硬件额定参数。

modeling_status.contract_format: DeviceSpec with structured condition/completion extensions; loader migration required

speed_mps.description: 非负目标表面速度；0 表示停止。0.4 m/s 为仿真初值，2 m/s 是初始软件限幅，非硬件额定值。

length_m.description: 按上层皮带网格估算的有效输送长度。当前 GLB 固定几何，未实现参数化拉伸，暂锁定为 1.4 m。

width_m.description: 按皮带网格估算的有效宽度；固定几何暂锁定为 0.5 m，不是整机包围盒宽度。

surface_height_m.description: 设备局部 Y 轴上的输送面高度；GLB 顶层皮带顶面约为 0.7 m，需场景交接标定。

transport_mode.description: 初版仅允许整带驱动。模型未提供独立分区驱动依据，不声明 zoned 模式。

allow_reverse.description: 初版固定为 false；反向能力尚未建模和接入，不因网格外观对称就声明支持。

capacity.description: 仿真允许的最大载荷单元数量，初值 3；实际接收还需检查载荷外形、间隙、支承和已有预留。非硬件承载认证。

resume_threshold.description: 数量积压锁存解除阈值，初值 2；数量降到该值后仍需满足入口与下游几何条件才能恢复。

accel_time_s.description: 从零到额定速度的加速时间；0表示理想瞬时切换

decel_time_s.description: 从额定速度到零的减速时间

position_tolerance_m.description: 出入口到达检测和交接位置的初始容差，需结合物料底部参考点与区域范围校准。

minimum_gap_m.description: 同时输送多件时的初始最小几何间隙；不等于存在独立分区驱动。

subject_at_exit.derivation: 指定 subject 的支承参考点位于出口有效检测区且速度满足接收方要求。

runtime_execution_contract.natural_language_fields: preconditions/effects are generated descriptions, not JavaScript or ST expressions to eval

discrete_task_gateway.identity_mapping: scene registry maps stable string task/subject IDs to DINT; no lossy string/REAL cast
discrete_task_gateway.acceptance: execute true + new valid request_id + free gateway + frozen valid arguments + all preconditions satisfied
discrete_task_gateway.idempotency: repeated same request_id cannot restart; stale execute true cannot restart after completion
discrete_task_gateway.result_retention: done/error/result_id retained until next valid request accepted
discrete_task_gateway.completion: all observed checks true for the accepted request and subject; continuous drive never raises task done
discrete_task_gateway.concurrency: initial gateway accepts one discrete task per instance; multi-subject planning serializes requests and cannot independently drive the shared belt
discrete_task_gateway.rearm: execute must fall before a different new request can be accepted; request_id rollover only after acknowledged quiescent reset
discrete_task_gateway.reset: clear resettable fault only after cause cleared; preserve last result correlation and actual material ownership until acknowledged

command_arbitration.transfer_control: stop and acknowledge previous owner before switching
command_arbitration.speed_resolution: unbound local preview uses speed_mps; bound mode uses speedTag; never simultaneously apply both
command_arbitration.dispatch: run false or effective target zero -> stop_conveying; stopped to positive -> start_conveying; positive target change -> set_speed; negative -> reject
command_arbitration.task_drive: task gateway requests drive through the same arbiter; it cannot overwrite runTag or bypass a stop/interlock

whole_belt_policy.downstream_wait: brake the entire belt before the leading load crosses the exit; preserve every carried load
whole_belt_policy.braking_guard: remaining_distance must exceed actual_speed^2/(2*configured_deceleration) + safety_margin; derive deceleration from reference_speed_mps/decel_time_s; zero time means explicit ideal stop
whole_belt_policy.geometry_guard: consider leading edge, whole subject footprint and all co-moving loads; a contact reference reaching the edge alone is not proof of support
whole_belt_policy.release_permission: FALSE prevents crossing exit, does not independently stop one load while other belt sections move
whole_belt_policy.unsupported: cannot promise independent per-load positioning, zero-pressure accumulation or geometric collision freedom from capacity alone

material_motion.method: future adapter chooses observed kinematic support transport or contact physics explicitly
material_motion.path_source: derived flow_input/flow_output in device local space transformed once by instance transform
material_motion.subject_reference: support contact reference; material COM offset comes from the subject DeviceSpec
material_motion.position_write_owner: one adapter/physics owner per material, no concurrent direct transform writes

animation_hooks.note: 仅为未来适配函数职责约定，尚无这些已实现/已注册函数；禁止按 duration 或 progress 自动报告成功。

model_geometry.bounds_source: all binary POSITION vertices; all source node transforms identity

conveyor_geometry.dimensions_policy: fixed GLB dimensions; change asset calibration and parameter contract together

motion_model.ramp: linear simulation profile at fixed reference speed; do not retime ramps by changing speed setpoint

detection_model.region_policy: derive entry/exit volumes from port frame, belt width and subject footprint; calibrate before execution

encoder_model.counter_update: integrate observed actual_speed over simulation dt
encoder_model.pulse_policy: one sampled BOOL pulse per crossing; enable only if simulation and PLC sampling preserve an intervening low sample; otherwise use encoderTag delta and runtime event counts

validation_rules.rule: transport_mode = continuous AND allow_reverse = false AND speed_mps >= 0
length_m = 1.4 AND width_m = 0.5 AND surface_height_m = 0.7 until mesh resize/calibration adapter exists
asset SHA256 and every gltf_node_index/name must match before binding
adapter registered AND geometry calibrated AND all referenced observations/authorizations available
grant/reservation observations come from independent services; device cannot assert its own resource grant
